_meta.description: Persistent listing image cache. One row per (store_id, country_code, seller_sku). Populated automatically after GET_MERCHANT_LISTINGS_ALL_DATA syncs via ListingsItems API — fetch-once, only new SKUs trigger API calls. Variation parentage (parent_sku, parent_asin) comes from the same call; group children under parent_sku to build families. No date in the unique key, so report_date='latest' applies no date filter here (omitting it works too) — never pin an explicit date, which would return only the SKUs touched by the newest enrichment batch.

columns.note: Marketplace country code e.g. AE, SA, US
Main product image URL from Amazon CDN (nullable if no image or enrichment failed)
Listing status string from ListingsItems API e.g. BUYABLE (nullable)
Timestamp when this row was last fetched/inserted
Variation parent's seller SKU for a child listing; the listing's own SKU for a parent; NULL for a standalone listing (from the ListingsItems relationships)
The variation parent's ASIN when known (a parent's own; a child's once its parent's row is cached); NULL otherwise
When Amazon last answered this SKU's variation relationships; NULL = not asked yet (filled on a later enrichment pass)
